Looking for a self-hosted file-sharing platform?

SnowShare is a free, open-source tool for sharing files, links, and text or code snippets.

Create password-protected shares with expiration dates and view limits. It also supports resumable uploads, QR codes, S3 storage, and ShareX integration.

Easy to deploy with Docker.

More details & alternatives:
https://digitalescapetools.com/tools/snowshare.html
